title: Achala Swarm — Overview
seo_title: Achala Swarm — Overview | Achala IT Solutions
meta_description: Hundreds of agents as one governed, measurable workforce.

blocks.x: Hundreds of agents as one governed, measurable workforce.

Achala Swarm is the orchestration layer for agentic operations: role definitions, task queues and bidding, durable execution with saga compensation, policy envelopes (solo/approval/forbidden), per-team budgets, kill switches, and a control tower for fleet health, throughput and cost per completed task.

Swarm treats agents as workforce, not scripts: onboarding with role specs, SLAs and budget; release management with shadow and canary cohorts; incident response with rollback. It runs our agentic process automation, digital workforce and workflow orchestration services under one accountable control plane.

roles, bidding, priority lanes, SLA routing

blocks.x: Every agent action is policy-checked and logged under immutable audit trails. Tool access is scoped per role with short-lived credentials; high-risk actions require approval workflows. Swarm's evidence pack maps to ISO 42001 and NIST AI RMF expectations for agentic systems.

items: every artifact the platform produces doubles as audit evidence — no reconstruction projects.

blocks.x: Most programs deploy Achala Swarm inside the customer's landing zone with a Achala pod operating it through a named run model, then transfer operations to client teams once the SLOs have held for two quarters.
Certified integration surface: Temporal, LangGraph, Kafka, OPA, Kubernetes, core/SaaS connectors.
Primary industry deployments: Banking & Financial Services, Insurance & Risk, Telecom, Media & Entertainment, Logistics & Supply Chain, Public Sector & Government, Technology & SaaS.
